title: [Audit] Kibana session reconstruction
description: Replay a user’s Kibana session. Filter to one Session to see exactly what that person did; newest first and capped at the newest 1,000 events in range, so sort Time ascending to read it forward. Kibana events only, because sessions are a Kibana concept. Operation uses the same words as the saved-object activity session (get, resolve, create …); an event that names no object keeps its own action, such as “http request” for a public API call or “user login”. Kibana’s internal UI requests, page assets, usage telemetry, the content-management calls that duplicate each object read, space lookups and point-in-time internals are left out; public /api/ requests are kept, because an export or import is one. Message is the sentence Kibana wrote for each event. An Identity that reads as an opaque id is a principal whose events carry no email and no key name — usually an organisation-level Elastic Cloud API key, which the audit stream records only by its id.
esql: FROM logs-elastic_cloud.serverless_audit.otel-default | WHERE resource.attributes.service.name == "serverless-kibana" | WHERE attributes.kibana.session.id IS NOT NULL | WHERE attributes.event.action IS NULL OR NOT (attributes.event.action IN ("saved_object_open_point_in_time", "saved_object_close_point_in_time", "space_get", "space_find") OR (attributes.event.action == "http_request" AND (NOT body.text LIKE "*/api/*" OR body.text LIKE "*/api/ui_counters/*" OR body.text LIKE "*/api/content_management/*"))) | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 1000 | EVAL actor = COALESCE(attributes.user.email, attributes.api_key.name, attributes.user.name, "<anonymous>") | EVAL verb = CASE(attributes.event.action LIKE "*_execution_cancel", "cancel", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_run_soon", "run", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_run", "run", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_test", "test", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_enable", "enable", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_disable", "disable", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_put_*", "create", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_open_*", "open", attributes.event.action LIKE "ml_start_*", "start", attributes.event.action LIKE "*point_in_time", "pit", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_create*", "create", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_update*", "update", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_delete", "delete", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_find", "find", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_get", "get", attributes.event.action LIKE "*_resolve", "resolve", "other") | EVAL op = CASE(verb != "other", verb, COALESCE(REPLACE(attributes.event.action, "_", " "), "other")) | KEEP @timestamp, actor, attributes.kibana.session.id, op, attributes.kibana.saved_object.type, attributes.kibana.saved_object.name, attributes.kibana.space.id, body.text | RENAME @timestamp AS Time, actor AS Identity, attributes.kibana.session.id AS Session, op AS Operation, attributes.kibana.saved_object.type AS `Object type`, attributes.kibana.saved_object.name AS Object, attributes.kibana.space.id AS Space, body.text AS Message
